snippet.title: Dirty Civilian
snippet.description:
Our mission is to inspire and inform capable men to build strong families and resilient communities.
We cover a variety of topics and subjects involving survival, bushcraft, modern military tech, and marksmanship fundamentals.
Merch and resources available at https://www.dirtycivilian.com

Hosts: Drew Hopkins & Josh Lowry
Videographer: Chad Barber (RIP Nick Jones)
Script & Research: Jonathan Fisher
